records.text: Owens introduced the quoted student-group message with “Apparently”; its unnamed sender said student roof access was close to where Charlie Kirk would be set up and the Sorensen Student Center had staircases leading to rooftop walkways.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #16 (Ep aLJhpxrakCU)

appearances.snippet: This is the original text message. From Dan Flood, and he says, hello, Chief Long (Jeffrey Long), we received this message today from the student group. ... And then he quotes it. Apparently the student is saying to them, there is student roof access pretty close to where CK will be set up at Utah Valley. The Sorensen Student Center has a couple of staircases that go up to the walkways on the roof, okay?

conveyance.original_source: Student-group message quoted inside Dan Flood message to Chief Long, read by Owens
